focus: Decision-capture paths and README fidelity; DSH hook registration vs every .skilled/hooks/*/dsh/ adapter

label: The decision-capture concern has no concern-level README (six folder-level READMEs, zero landing document) while 25 of 27 sibling concerns have one; the shipped guard cannot notice because bin/runtime-refusal.test.mjs resolves '../../README.md' from decision-capture/bin/, i.e. .skilled/hooks/README.md, and asserts the registry row there instead of a per-concern coverage document.

DECISION_CAPTURE_README_PATH is a test seam with no writer: it appears exactly once in the repository, at its own definition in bin/runtime-refusal.test.mjs:12, so the override has never selected a file and the guard always reads .skilled/hooks/README.md. Removing it changes nothing today; wiring it to .skilled/hooks/decision-capture/README.md is the one-line change that makes f-iter021-001 assertable.

The DSH advisor is the only one of 21 registered adapters that is opt-in (registerPromptAdvisor receives { enabled: options.promptAdvisor === true }) while the other 20 register with undefined and default on; the sole switch is .dsh/patches/guards.patch.yml:6, so any install route that does not reproduce that patch silently loses the advisor brief with no error and no log line.

The decision-capture hook and the save-time reader compute one queue location from one token: QUEUE_RELATIVE_DIR '.skilled/skills/.state/decision-capture' joined under canonicalRoot, keyed by sha256(canonicalRoot).slice(0,12) in capture-core.mjs:40,272-278, matched verbatim by STATE_DIR_SEGMENTS and projectToken in decision-record-writer.ts:125,164-165,804-807. A change to either side alone breaks answer recovery.

No unregistered DSH adapter exists: 12 real adapter files across .skilled/hooks/*/dsh/ all reach .dsh/plugins/repo-guards/adapters/ as relative symlinks and every one appears in apply(); git-live-follow and git-primary-reconcile ship .sh links run by session-start-advisories, matching their READMEs; 0 of 12 links broken.

The DSH decision-capture README matches its code exactly: three handlers (tools/result, session/event, agent/status), fail-open error policy, source:'hook' tagging and takeNudge at idle are all present in decision-capture.mjs:67-113 as documented at dsh/README.md:25.

Both decision-capture node:test suites are green at HEAD read-only: 44 pass / 0 fail for tests/ + lib/ + dsh/, and 84 pass / 0 fail for bin/. The missing concern README is therefore invisible to the shipped suites, not a red test.

direction: A DSH concern ships an adapter under .skilled/hooks/*/dsh/ that the repo-guards bundle never registers
reason: Enumerated all 18 dsh folders: 12 real adapter files, each symlinked into .dsh/plugins/repo-guards/adapters/ and each named in apply() at index.mjs:45-68; the six README-only folders link to modules that are themselves linked into the same adapters folder; the two .sh links are executed by session-start-advisories per their own READMEs. Nothing is unregistered.

direction: The decision-capture hook writes relative to process.cwd() so a subdirectory launch scatters the queue
reason: sessionOf prefers agent.session.header.cwd and capture-core re-anchors through git rev-parse --show-toplevel with GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE scrubbed and a realpath/resolve fallback (capture-core.mjs:242-268); the process.cwd() default at decision-capture.mjs:58 is a last-resort fallback only.
